cases.name: sidecar_mls_bootstrap_binding
assertions: participant authority transcript contains the sorted unique Realm-scoped desired Agent set
Sidecar genesis is Event-derived and MLS binds the native Sidecar scope
server-generated MLS private state and synthetic GroupInfo digests are forbidden
a concurrent losing provisional snapshot is destroyed

cases.name: sidecar_mls_effective_access
assertions: desired membership alone without accepted Add Commit Welcome and target-device consume remains pending
one active authorized Agent device with matching evidence makes the Agent principal effective
current controller device readiness is evaluated separately from effective_agent_ids
desired membership removal stops delivery before the Remove Commit lands
the Principal Server creates a removal obligation but never fabricates an MLS Commit
the dedicated Sidecar view exposes a sorted non-empty authority frontier without creating Circle membership
the controller persists signed Remove events and advances its post-commit snapshot only after accepted submission

cases.name: sidecar_ensure_idempotent
assertions: ensure operation id remains ak.self.agent.sidecar.command.ensure
ensure capability action matches the operation id
prepare returns a closed new or existing branch with Event-derived sidecar id, source context, Event IDs and canonical unsigned draft bytes
the controller may append proofs but any unsigned-byte, payload, Event ID, source context, or refs.after mutation conflicts with zero writes
create and attach produce no Circle membership Strand or Relation object
sidecar profile id remains ak.profile.agent_sidecar.v1

cases.name: sidecar_eligibility_states
assertions: paused agents are removed from the derived desired set and effective sidecar access
deactivated agents are excluded from effective access and trigger native Sidecar MLS removal
desired and effective Agent sets remain distinct until reconciliation completes
default home policy remains context_realm_preferred

cases.name: sidecar_existence_privacy
assertions: callers without sidecar ensure capability receive sidecar_create_denied
an unauthorized caller never learns Sidecar existence; only the authorized controller receives the fixed new|existing prepare branch

cases.name: sidecar_hosted_projection
assertions: track_name and message_id are rejected in ensure context_ref
one native Sidecar context mapping is reused across all source Strand Tracks
display mode is encrypted per-context view state and defaults to context_merged
each source-routed exchange has an independent device-local Event-fold cache and stable source-event order
sidecar-native events create no source echo
merged projection deduplicates the private request Event by Event id

cases.name: sidecar_multi_agent_publish
assertions: ensure, write, exchange control, and publish capability actions all remain Agent Sidecar scoped
the sidecar capability action quartet contains no duplicates and exchange control is controller-only

cases.name: sidecar_exchange_binding_closed_loop
assertions: the routed request event carries a role=request binding with a full request_context, completion_policy=coordinator, and a valid coordinator assignment
the agent runtime learns the exchange identity only from the decrypted request binding; exchange projection is never Account Data or an account-stream object
the runtime executes only when its own principal is addressed, active, eligible, effective, MLS-ready, the Event is the canonical request for exchange_id, and that exchange_id is not already consumed
the runtime persists exchange_id to canonical request_event_id; a later request Event reusing the same exchange_id fails closed and cannot execute again

a validated role=user_facing_response binding with matching exchange_id, request_event_id, causal request ref, native Sidecar scope, source context, and addressed actor is the only path into user_facing_response_event_ids
the accepted request folds to delivered; validated role=internal events keep that state and stay non-echo without producing errors
wrong exchange_id, wrong request_event_id, wrong Sidecar scope, missing causal ref, non-addressed actor, unknown role, and ak:message: shaped request references all fail closed to non-echo
a role=request binding on an agent-authored event is invalid and never consumed
duplicate delivery of the same response event id appends exactly once and the response set keeps canonical (event HLC, event id) byte order

a non-coordinator completes_exchange request never closes the exchange; a valid coordinator request causes the controller to author a durable close control Event, and only that Event advances terminal state

cases.name: sidecar_exchange_projection_recovery
assertions: after local cache loss the controller rebuilds from accepted private Event history without redelivering the agent request
agent-authored role=request bindings are excluded from rebuild by consumer-side actor validation
independent controller devices replaying validation over the same private history produce bit-identical response sets, canonical order, and status
incomparable local folded frontiers are never resolved by HLC or LWW; devices backfill and fold the joined accepted history
folded_frontier carries canonical maximal causal heads, a digest of all contributing Event ids, and max HLC; it is local cache validation metadata only
close or cancel with a non-empty captured response set produces complete; close empty produces controller_closed_empty and cancel empty produces controller_cancelled
agent or control events concurrent with and not causally covered by the winning terminal basis remain private audit history but do not enter the terminal projection

same-sequence control siblings use event-digest bytewise maximum, the first effective terminal control absorbs later controls, and reassignment is valid only before terminal with a matching expected coordinator
delivered requires empty responses, responding/complete require non-empty responses, failed requires empty responses plus failure_reason_code, and non-failed states forbid failure_reason_code

cases.name: sidecar_exchange_binding_containment
assertions: plaintext metadata carrying sidecar_exchange_binding, the binding schema id, or an exchange_id value is a schema_violation hard reject on the wire
binding or control plaintext decrypted from a non-Sidecar scope is invalid and never rendered or folded
explicit publish output is an ordinary shared event carrying no binding, exchange_id, sidecar_id, or private locator
publish output, shared history, Account Data, push previews, notifications, and public telemetry have zero hits for exchange_id, binding schema id, and control schema id

cases.name: sidecar_context_locator_recovery
assertions: all sidecar-list and event-scan pages complete before any locator becomes echo-eligible
only a controller-authored accepted sidecar.context.attach recovers the native context mapping
the mapping points to an already existing canonical source context and creates no Relation
duplicate or conflicting candidates remain unresolved and all exchange events remain non-echo
unauthorized callers receive an indistinguishable empty result

cases.name: sidecar_canonical_sibling_digest
assertions: same actor_seq siblings are decided by the bytewise maximum canonical accepted Event envelope digest
reversing arrival and database order does not change the winner
event id and HLC order are explicit counterexamples and cannot substitute for event_digest

cases.name: sidecar_union_history_frontier
assertions: incomparable device histories trigger full pagination and a refold over their set union
event_ids contains every maximal causal head rather than an HLC winner
event_set_digest covers the sorted unique ids of every participating Event
a missing page or invisible head preserves the old cache and marks backfill pending

cases.name: sidecar_non_disclosure_surface_matrix
assertions: every listed surface has zero disclosure of every forbidden class
private state changes do not alter shared counts ordering unread watch notification or search results
the server neither decrypts nor persists exchange plaintext or fold input

cases.name: sidecar_revoke_fail_closed
assertions: accepted revoke pause or deactivate immediately stops new addressing and delivery
runtime eligibility and authorization freshness are revalidated immediately before execution
old keys sessions and cached projections cannot authorize a new write or response
lifecycle changes never create an implicit exchange terminal

cases.name: sidecar_explicit_publish
assertions: without controller confirmation publication produces zero shared durable output
one confirmation produces exactly one ordinary shared Event from an allowlist builder
the shared Event contains none of the forbidden private identifiers history or locators

cases.name: sidecar_accepted_request_identity
assertions: the runtime persists exchange_id to the accepted request Event id only
response binding request_event_id and top-level after ref equal the same accepted Event id
the controller fold accepts only that Event id
message local-intent and unaccepted Event identities all fail closed

cases.name: sidecar_hosted_ui_matrix
assertions: Chrome and Edge execute the full cross-product against a stable build
realm tree sidecar view and private history seed are asserted before product checks
track and mode switching preserves scroll editor and draft state
switching is incremental and does not replay full history
